description: Connector MCP tools that have a CLI dispatch definition (src/tool-dispatch/) and still register a handler of their own in src/cli/connect/mcp/tools/. Every other connector tool runs its dispatch definition (dispatch-tools.ts). Seeded 2026-10-05 (secaudit 2026-10, M3): each one listed here was measured to differ from its dispatch definition in the HTTP request it sends or the result it answers, against a node that answers and one that refuses, or it is one of the tools whose connector takes other parameters than the node (security/mcp-schema-single-source.json). Not yet reviewed: which side is right is decided per tool by reading its route. Settling one means making the two the same and deleting the handler. scripts/audit-mcp-schemas.ts (pnpm check:mcp-schemas) refuses a new handler and a listed one that is gone. The list only shrinks.
